$comment: Dependency policy of yugen-ui, checked by scripts/check-deps.mjs (#383). maxPackages: packages installed with yugen-ui, lowered when one goes away. allow: accepted findings, each with a reason and a review date. CONTRIBUTING.md > Dependencies.

allow.name: detect-node-es
allow.reason: Last release 2021-03. Comes from react-remove-scroll (use-sidecar), which Radix Dialog, Popover, Select and Menu use. Under 1 kB, no I/O. Goes away when Radix drops react-remove-scroll.

allow.name: get-nonce
allow.reason: Last release 2020-04. Comes from react-remove-scroll (react-style-singleton), which Radix Dialog, Popover, Select and Menu use. Under 1 kB, no I/O. Goes away when Radix drops react-remove-scroll.

allow.name: tslib
allow.reason: 2.9.1 is the first version published by the npm account microsoft1es (earlier versions: typescript-bot), a Microsoft build account. Comes from the react-remove-scroll family.

allow.name: class-variance-authority
allow.reason: Published without provenance. src/lib/cvx.ts builds the component variants on it; one small file, no dependencies.

allow.name: clsx
allow.reason: Published without provenance. cn() uses it to join class names; under 1 kB, no dependencies.

allow.name: cmdk
allow.reason: Published without provenance. Only Command still uses it: Combobox, TagPicker and TimePicker moved to the own listbox (#351).

allow.name: react-resizable-panels
allow.reason: Published without provenance. Only Resizable uses it; an own splitter is planned (#356).
